install.label: Install arc
install.steps: Install arc: tap {share}, then {addToHome}. Then log in inside the installed app — it does not share Safari's sign-in.

outbox.failedHelp: The server refused these. They are kept here so nothing you logged is lost.

today.title: Today
today.loadFailed: Could not load today. Is the API reachable?
today.targetsStrength: This session is prescribed in sets and reps, not in channels.
today.targetsNone: No channel targets on this prescription.
today.watchForNone: Nothing noted. Add what to watch for when you plan or revise the session.
today.restBody: Rest is prescribed as much as anything else is. If that is wrong, plan something — it will appear here and on the calendar.

wellness.title: Wellness
wellness.notActionable: Recorded, but not actionable today: {reasons}. The numbers are real; they just do not say anything about readiness this morning.
wellness.asked: arc asked about this morning and has not heard back. Sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, weight and how you feel — whatever you have.
wellness.openUntil: Open until {time}; after that the day closes unanswered and is not asked again.
wellness.closed: This morning closed unanswered — arc asked and nothing was recorded. It will not ask again for today.
wellness.nothingYet: Nothing recorded this morning. Sleep, resting heart rate, HRV, weight and how you feel — whatever you have.

firstRun.question: Have you lifted before?
firstRun.why: It sets how much arc asks you in the gym. You can change it any time in Settings.

beforeYouStart.title: Before you start
beforeYouStart.lead: A few things to know before your first session.
beforeYouStart.pain: Sharp pain, or pain in a joint: stop that exercise. Tap ⋯ and then Pain.
beforeYouStart.redFlag: Chest pain, fainting or numbness: stop at once. Tap ⋯ and then Stop.
beforeYouStart.easy: Start light. Leave a few reps in the tank while you learn a move.
beforeYouStart.notAdvice: arc is a training log. It is not medical advice.
beforeYouStart.under18Message: Under 18: arc will never ask for a max effort. Lift with an adult who knows how to coach you.

train.missing: This session is not on this phone yet. Connect once so arc can fetch it.
train.doneBody: {count} sets logged. They upload as soon as there is a connection.

effort.questionReps: How many more reps could you have done?
effort.noneLabel: 0 reps left, none — log the set
effort.cappedLabel: 4 or more reps left, felt easy — log the set

rest.label: Rest
rest.ended: Rest is over. Time for the next set.
rest.wakeLock: Your phone may lock between sets. Rest alerts then need notifications.

finish.title: Finish
finish.question: How hard was the whole session?
finish.dontLearnHelp: Keeps today in your history but out of next weights.

records.historyMissing: This exercise is not in the catalogue.
records.historyEmpty: No sets of this exercise logged yet. Log it in a session and your bests appear here.
records.estimateNote: A rough guide from rated sets, never a personal best.
records.notEnoughDataHelp: Rate the last set of this exercise in three sessions to see an estimate.
records.repMaxMissing: No set of {reps} or more reps yet

pain.title: Where is the pain?
pain.stopped: {exercise}: stopped for today because of sharp pain.

redFlag.title: What is happening?
redFlag.advice: Stop training and get medical advice today.
redFlag.ended: The session has ended. What you logged is saved.

why.title: Why {weight}?

because.top_at_limit: top of the range, nothing left
because.big_step: the next step is a big one
because.plateau_step: holding steady, try a small step
because.plateau_reps: holding steady, try one more rep
because.plateau_reset: holding steady, step back and rebuild

why.lastTwo: Your last two sessions: {set}{effort} each time.
why.aims: The plan aims for {left} reps left.
why.soUp: So there's a little more in you — {weight} today.
why.soDown: So that was more than planned — {weight} today.
why.soReps: So stay at {weight} and aim for {reps} reps.
why.change: You can change it. arc uses what you actually lift.
why.limitUp: → held at the most a lift may rise in one go
why.limitDown: → held at the most a lift may drop in one go
why.limitStep: → held to one step, as for a small muscle
why.limitBigStep: → the next step is too big, so one more rep first
why.rounded: → nearest loadable weight with your plates = {weight}.

basis.estimate: Coaching practice, built on a standard strength estimate
